review:
This movie takes the hard job of getting a board game that is open by nature and adapt to a movie that has a beginning, middle and ending, and it does that really well.

The characters, the mansion that serves as the main scenery, the comedy bits and even the story can get a bit too cartoony, but that’s undeniably a charm of the movie.

Aside from the good humor of the script, the mystery of who did it with what and where is well executed and leave us wondering what the solution is all the time.

Just like playing a game of Clue, watching the movie can be just as satisfying and fun.
